body.x: EKLEER (CEO Matthew Chung), headquartered in Pangyo Techno Valley, has been recognized as an Innovation Awards Honoree in the Computer Peripherals and Accessories category at CES 2025, solidifying its global reputation for technological excellence. EKLEER focuses on developing affordable and innovative digital solutions for emerging markets to bridge the digital divide. Its award-winning smart display, MOVVI, has drawn attention for its cost-effective and highly efficient digital inclusion technology.

MOVVI is a 21.5-inch Full HD smart display that leverages Android smartphones to support diverse digital activities such as education, work, and healthcare. It connects seamlessly via a USB-C port, ensuring uninterrupted charging and functionality, while the USB-A hub enhances compatibility with peripheral devices. Additionally, dual 8W speakers deliver an immersive multimedia experience, maximizing user convenience.

EKLEER’s smart display boasts an intuitive design, enabling users to transform their smartphones into powerful large-scale workstations. Particularly impactful in underprivileged communities, MOVVI provides significant opportunities to enhance digital productivity in educational and professional settings.

Matthew Chung, CEO of EKLEER, remarked, “This award reaffirms our vision to expand digital productivity and educational accessibility in emerging markets. We hope MOVVI enables more people to benefit from the power of technology.”

body.cap: MOVVI Smart Display | Image provided by EKLEER

body.x: Through its smart display development, EKLEER is focused on lowering technological barriers and reducing the digital divide among underserved populations in emerging markets. The display empowers users to access educational materials, perform work tasks, and utilize smartphone telehealth services, driving technological accessibility and fostering meaningful social impact.

The CES Innovation Awards recognize consumer technology products' excellence in innovation, engineering, and user experience. EKLEER’s smart display received high praise for addressing the needs of emerging market users while delivering cost-efficient digital solutions.

EKLEER’s achievements underscore its commitment to solving social challenges in emerging markets through affordable and sustainable technology. This award represents a pivotal milestone, positioning EKLEER as a leader in bridging the digital divide and opening new possibilities in the global market.

Pangyo Techno Valley is a global integrated R&D hub focused on IT, BT, CT, and NT, integrating Research (R), People (P), Information (I), and Trade (T). As Gyeonggi-do’s representative innovation cluster, Pangyo Techno Valley was established to secure national new growth drivers such as technological innovation, human resource development, job creation, and enhancing international business competitiveness. As of 2023, 1,666 companies employ 78,751 people, and it has positioned itself as the most innovative hub in South Korea, with sales amounting to 167.7 trillion KRW (125.5 billion USD).

Furthermore, the Techno Valley Innovation Division of the Gyeonggi-do Business & Science Accelerator (GBSA) holds monthly events such as the Pangyo Evening Meet-Up, Pan-Pan Day, and the Pangyo Startup Investment Exchange “In-Best Pangyo” to maximize the value of Pangyo Techno Valley. They also support the Pangyo Overseas Promotion Program, which publicizes information about Pangyo’s companies, products, and services to domestic and foreign investors and the media, thereby facilitating foreign investment.
